summary.text: Kenton Patzkowsky is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 61, elected to the House in 2018. His House biography says the district is the largest in the state and includes Cimarron, Texas, Beaver, Ellis, Harper and part of Woodward counties.

paragraphs.text: His House biography says Patzkowsky serves as vice chair of the Agriculture Committee and is on the Transportation and Utilities committees.
His legislative priorities include the protection and sustainability of Oklahoma agriculture.
Patzkowsky is married to Anna, and the family farm near Balko in southwest Beaver County has been in the family for many generations.
They have two children and four grandchildren.
